messages:
maya: FYI - three racks in eu-central1 are reporting elevated write retries during nightly ephemeral GC. Not a full outage but GPU pods failing to bind intermittently.

tom: Do we have logs showing attach errors or disk read/write CRCs?

leo: Early logs: repeated journal warnings and NVMe error counters incrementing: 

leo: ```
[ 98765.432100] nvme1n1: I/O 0xdef456 failed, status: 0x4
[ 98765.432201] nvme1n1: WRITE CRC error sector 123456
[ 98765.432330] nvme1: controller reset due to fatal error
```

maya: Drives affected are a mixed cohort but skew toward 1.6TB units with serial prefix NX1-3. We pushed a new ephemeral-cleaner tuning last week that increased aggressive tombstone consolidation.

ana: Could the cleaner be creating large multi-extent writes that trigger write-amplification on those low-capacity drives?

leo: That's my hypothesis. In a repro, running the cleaner at high concurrency causes write latency to spike and the controller to hit internal recovery multiple times.

ops-oncall: infra-bot: re-route policy engaged for eu-central1: limit new GPU launches to 30% of normal until mitigations applied.

infra-bot: Action taken: set routing weight eu-central1=0.3 -> reason: nvme-error-surge.

tom: Mitigations we can enact immediately: lower cleaner concurrency, disable multi-extent coalesce for the affected serial prefix, and mark suspect nodes as avoid-for-provisioning.

maya: I'll roll a quick config change to pause coalesce on the NX1-3 cohort. Also will add a node annotation to k8s to opt-out of scheduling GPU workloads.

leo: I'll dump SMART + nvme-cli telemetry for the affected nodes and correlate with controller resets and temp sensors. Early SMART shows increasing media_errors on three drives.

vendor-support: Thanks for the telemetry. Please open a ticket with the controller debug logs and firmware revision. Any chance you can test a conservative FW setting?

maya: Firmware across cohort is 3.2.9. We'll gather logs and request vendor triage.

tom: Provisioner change: add detect/retry for "WRITE CRC" and perform automatic host fallthrough to next healthy candidate. I'll push a small canary patch that retries attach 3x with exponential backoff.

ops-oncall: Note - routing to other regions will increase cost and may hit soft quota in us-east1. Estimate ~ $1.5k/day if we keep eu-central1 at 30% for 48h.

ana: Customer impact check - are any data-local customers affected?

maya: One internal training job observed higher tail latency but no persisted data loss yet. We'll flag externally if we see pod restarts > 5% baseline.

leo: After applying cleaner pause on 6 test hosts, attach success rate improved from ~88% -> 99% and GPU attach latency median fell from 14s -> 2.8s. Can confirm correlation.

maya: Good. Next actions: 1) Keep cleaner paused for NX1-3 nodes 2) Run full telemetry collection + open vendor ticket (assigned to vendor-support) 3) Provisioner retry canary from tom 4) Maintain routing weight to 0.3 until stable 5) Cost & impact note for ops.

tom: PR coming in 45m, will canary to 10 hosts first.

vendor-support: Ticket acknowledged - please attach nvme core dumps and syslog bundle. We'll check if FW 3.2.9 has known CRC handling regressions.

ops-oncall: I'll update #incidents and coordinate quota increases if needed. Also recommending delaying any fleet-wide cleaner tuning rollout until vendor confirms.

maya: Thanks team. Will post when vendor responds or if we see regression. :thumbsup:
